$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{AB} & =b-a \\  & =(-i-2j-k)-(-2i-2j-3k) \\  & =i+2k \\  & =⟨1,0,2⟩ \\ \overset{\to }{AC} & =c-a \\  & =(-2i-4j-2k)-(-2i-2j-3k) \\  & =-2j+k \\  & =⟨0,-2,1⟩\end{aligned}
$$

Now, using the formula to compute the cross product, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{AB}\times \overset{\to }{AC} & =|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ 1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & -2 & 1\end{aligned}| \\  & =|\begin{aligned}0 & 2 \\ -2 & 1\end{aligned}|i-|\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 0 & 1\end{aligned}|j+|\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ 0 & -2\end{aligned}|k \\  & =(0\cdot 1-2\cdot (-2))i-(1\cdot 1-2\cdot 0)j+(1\cdot (-2)-0\cdot 0)k \\  & =4i-j-2k \\  & =⟨4,-1,-2⟩.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the area of the parallelogram spanned by $\overset{\to }{AB}$ and $\overset{\to }{AC}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =|\overset{\to }{AB}\times \overset{\to }{AC}| \\  & =\sqrt{{4}^{2}+(-1)^{2}+(-2)^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{21}.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, the area of the triangle is half of the area of the respective parallelogram. So, the area of $△\,ABC$ is

$$
{A}_{△}=\frac{1}{2}A=\frac{\sqrt{21}}{2}.
$$" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy :question/answer-fields ["1fe13558-c04f-55d0-9b8b-2599812b93b7"] :db/ensure :question/validate} {:db/id "dd4f54f7-762f-559c-b251-2e94eff699ba" :answer/id #uuid "dd4f54f7-762f-559c-b251-2e94eff699ba" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "3" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "5a4d44ac-7a04-53af-883c-d84299462108" :answer/id #uuid "5a4d44ac-7a04-53af-883c-d84299462108" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "18" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "6cb14737-a4dc-5c33-8d76-db1413b3c0b0" :answer/id #uuid "6cb14737-a4dc-5c33-8d76-db1413b3c0b0" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "6" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "d6bb03c8-6969-593a-bebd-f73b084888a5" :answer/id #uuid "d6bb03c8-6969-593a-bebd-f73b084888a5" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "\sqrt{10}" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "fdd39de1-2821-5e1a-ac29-859d1dc8b192" :answer/id #uuid "fdd39de1-2821-5e1a-ac29-859d1dc8b192" :answer/type :answer.type/math :answer/value "1" :db/ensure :answer/validate} {:db/id "c7356952-eb01-5c8f-ad3e-2396e474424e" :answer-field/id #uuid "c7356952-eb01-5c8f-ad3e-2396e474424e" :answer-field/key "selection" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/radio :answer-field/choices ["dd4f54f7-762f-559c-b251-2e94eff699ba" "5a4d44ac-7a04-53af-883c-d84299462108" "6cb14737-a4dc-5c33-8d76-db1413b3c0b0" "d6bb03c8-6969-593a-bebd-f73b084888a5" "fdd39de1-2821-5e1a-ac29-859d1dc8b192"] :answer-field/correct "dd4f54f7-762f-559c-b251-2e94eff699ba" :db/ensure :answer-field/validate} {:db/id "ea1dd373-8a23-58ba-959d-745d87d1958b" :question/id #uuid "ea1dd373-8a23-58ba-959d-745d87d1958b" :question/problem "Calculate the area of the $△\,ABC$, if $A(2,1,-2)$, $B(0,0,-2)$, $C(2,3,0).$" :question/worked-solution "First, we find the vectors $\overset{\to }{AB}$ and $\overset{\to }{AC}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{AB} & =b-a \\  & =(-2k)-(2i+j-2k) \\  & =-2i-j \\  & =⟨-2,-1,0⟩ \\ \overset{\to }{AC} & =c-a \\  & =(2i+3j)-(2i+j-2k) \\  & =2j+2k \\  & =⟨0,2,2⟩\end{aligned}

Now, using the formula to compute the cross product, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{\to }{AB}\times \overset{\to }{AC} & =|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ -2 & -1 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 2\end{aligned}| \\  & =|\begin{aligned}-1 & 0 \\ 2 & 2\end{aligned}|i-|\begin{aligned}-2 & 0 \\ 0 & 2\end{aligned}|j+|\begin{aligned}-2 & -1 \\ 0 & 2\end{aligned}|k \\  & =((-1)\cdot 2-0\cdot 2)i-((-2)\cdot 2-0\cdot 0)j+((-2)\cdot 2-(-1)\cdot 0)k \\  & =-2i+4j-4k \\  & =⟨-2,4,-4⟩.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the area of the parallelogram spanned by $\overset{\to }{AB}$ and $\overset{\to }{AC}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =|\overset{\to }{AB}\times \overset{\to }{AC}| \\  & =\sqrt{(-2)^{2}+{4}^{2}+(-4)^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{36} \\  & =6.\end{aligned}

Finally, the area of the triangle is half of the area of the respective parallelogram. So, the area of $△\,ABC$ is

$$
{A}_{△}=\frac{1}{2}A=\frac{6}{2}=3.
